hook: DB load se [[phat]] raha hai? Replication karo

slides.title: [[Replication]] kya hai bhai?
points: DB ka data **doosre server** pe copy karna
Ek server down, toh doosra **zinda** hai
slides.note: Bole toh: Zomato ka backup DB. Ek gaya toh doosre se order chalega

slides.title: [[Kyun]] chahiye ye setup?
slides.note: Heavy traffic handle karne ka sabse mast tarika hai

slides.title: [[Master-Replica]] funda
points: Master saara data Replica ko **bhejta** hai
slides.note: Master = Captain, Replica = Team. Captain plan banata hai, team follow karti hai

slides.title: Master vs [[Replica]]
slides.note: Real world mein 1 Master aur kai saare Replicas hote hain

slides.title: Status [[check]] query
slides.note: Binlog (Binary Log) hi saara **jaadu** karta hai changes copy karne mein

slides.title: Replication ka [[Flow]]
slides.note: Isse **asynchronous** replication bolte hain. Network delay ho sakta hai

slides.wrong: Replica server par jaake **UPDATE query** chala dena
slides.right: Hamesha **Master pe write** karo, Replica pe select
slides.why: Replica pe direct write kiya toh **Data Mismatch** ho jayega aur sync toot jayega 💀
